prs.title: fix(workflow): reconcile blocked waves before resume
prs.problem_and_result: A blocked or unknown recovery marker could let resume skip a possibly live attempt and launch duplicate work. Keep it in exact-job reconciliation until evidence resolves it; treat pre-launch proof as an explicitly recorded integer zero and preserve verified terminal outcomes.
prs.controls: Adoption, unknown markers, verified cancellation, missing/false/non-integer launch sequence, and proven pre-launch cases.

prs.title: fix(workflow): recover durable output reuse across driver crashes
prs.problem_and_result: A driver crash after verified cancellation could lose output-reuse state and launch a replacement. Recover the same attempt from content-addressed cancellation evidence, bind its exact identities and read back its declared outputs. Preserve factual provider status. Transient history failures remain retryable; an interrupted cancellation decision returns to exact-job reconciliation.
prs.controls: Both persistence boundaries, unreadable/corrupt/ambiguous history, output readback, exact cancellation identity, incomplete cancellation and terminal-status races.

retained_validation_failures.initial_environment_repairs: Initial setup expected a prior task's archived wheelhouse. This task rebuilt its own tools and public wheelhouse. A scanner invocation used the wrong working directory, and earlier test runs placed temporary HOME fixtures under the host home directory; those failures were retained before correcting the validation environment. Final exact-head results above use the corrected environment without weakened assertions.
retained_validation_failures.procfs_permission_case: The first final #641 focused run had 1 failure and 2,043 passes: process ownership could not be inspected during API setup. A controlled same-UID nondumpable child reproduced the strict PermissionError boundary. The original failing PID cannot be identified from the retained traceback. Private PID/procfs/network isolation allowed the unchanged tests to pass; the ownership guard remains fail-closed.
retained_validation_failures.continuation_runner_correction: The first process-isolated continuation accidentally used an older runner with temporary HOME paths under the host home directory. It failed the home-isolation and wrapped-CLI-output controls. The latest-main continuation inherited that runner and was interrupted after the mistake was identified. Both retained their logs. The final continuations use the audited current runner with short temporary paths, restored signals, unchanged tests and separate process/network namespaces.
